name: Tabletop Siege
summary:
Tabletop Siege reads the room you are in and stands a battlefield on a real surface — a table, a desk, a couch, the end of a bed. You lean over it. You reach into it to place a turret. Enemies walk out of a rift at one end and your core sits at the other, and everything between them is happening on your own furniture.

⛰️ TERRAIN THAT FIGHTS BACK
• Hills break line of sight, water takes away the ground you wanted
• Where you build matters as much as what you build
